fda.text: FETAL TOXICITY See full prescribing information for complete boxed warning. When pregnancy is detected, discontinue enalapril maleate as soon as possible. Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus. (See WARNINGS: Fetal Toxicity .)

summary: In the United States, Enalapril carries the strongest type of warning from officials for heart harm and for teratogenicity, which means it can cause harm or death to an unborn baby [3][6]. Because of this danger to a developing fetus, the drug must be stopped as soon as pregnancy is detected [6]. It also includes a warning that patients may experience severe allergic-like reactions [6]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a medium risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M].
